layout_spacing.grid_strategy: Control Room Pattern. Strict hierarchy, dense data layout with 1px structural borders.

components.buttons: Flat, sharp edges. No border-radius (rounded-none). bg-black text-white hover:bg-black/90 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-black/20 focus:outline-none.
components.cards: border-collapse style. Flat surface, 1px border-border, no shadow. Active/High-Ratio states use 'Tracing Beam' effect with Gold.
components.inputs: Shadcn based. Sharp edges (rounded-none), 1px borders, solid white bg. High contrast focus rings.
components.tables: Sticky headers, alternating subtle zebra stripes (#FAFAFA), right-aligned numeric data. Monospace fonts for all table cells.
components.charts: Recharts. Monochromatic lines (black/gray) with Gold and Red highlights for anomalies/thresholds.

motion.hover: Subtle border color change. No floating or heavy shadows.
motion.alerts: Gold highlight pulse for >5 ratio. Smooth slide-in for AI insights.

specific_instructions: Use Phosphor Icons (yarn add @phosphor-icons/react) for dense, clean look.
Do NOT use HTML-based components for dropdowns or date pickers; ALWAYS use Shadcn with custom 0px radius styles.
Data grids must use IBM Plex Mono for all numbers to ensure tabular alignment.
Any gig with 'Competition-to-Order Ratio > 5' MUST have a stark gold border (border-amber-500) and background highlight (bg-amber-50).
The AI insight panel should use the AI avatar and have a distinct background tint (e.g., #FAFAFA) to separate it from data tables.
All interactive elements must have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
